items.definition:
entertainment held in a nightclub or restaurant while the audience eats or drinks
They enjoyed a lively cabaret show in Paris.

deception, trickery
His actions were full of deceit.

decorative needlework
She showed off her beautiful embroidery.

a system designed to prevent unauthorized access to a network
Make sure your computer's firewall is active.

a strong point, something one excels at
Public speaking is not my forte.

a small, slender, long-armed ape
The gibbon swung gracefully through the trees.

a person who is paid to kill someone
The police arrested the suspected hitman.

the act of secretly entering a place or organization
The police suspected infiltration by criminal elements into the organization.

special words or expressions used by a particular profession or group and difficult for others to understand
The legal document was full of technical jargon that was hard to understand.

the accidental escape of liquid, gas, or information
There was a significant leakage of data from the company's servers.

an ambiguity or inadequacy in a system, law, or contract which can be used to evade or circumvent it
He found a legal loophole to avoid paying the tax.

lack of proper nutrition, caused by not having enough to eat, not eating enough of the right things, or being unable to use the food that one does eat
Many children in developing countries suffer from malnutrition.

a large predatory marine fish with a long, pointed snout
The fisherman caught a huge marlin after a long struggle.

the quality or state of being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements
Despite her success, she always maintained a sense of modesty.

Spout
The garden hose has an adjustable nozzle.

Illegal position in sports
The player was called offside.

A covering layer
The designer added a transparent overlay to the image.

Fatherhood
He took paternity leave to care for his newborn.

Requirement
Good grades are a prerequisite for university admission.

A viral disease
Vaccination can prevent rabies in animals.

Fixed amount
During the drought, water was distributed in rations.

Reconnaissance
The soldiers went on a recon mission.

assistant, companion
Batman always had his trusty sidekick, Robin.

male horse
The powerful stallion galloped across the field.

woven wall hanging
A beautiful tapestry hung on the castle wall.

gentleness, sensitivity
He showed great tenderness towards the injured animal.

prickly plant
The field was full of thistles.

bottom surface
Check the underside of the car for rust.

maintenance
The upkeep of the old house was expensive.

vase for ashes
His ashes were kept in a beautiful urn.

a period of keeping awake during the time usually spent asleep, especially to keep watch or pray.
The family kept a vigil by his bedside all night.

a very rapid course of events.
The trip was a whirlwind of activities.

a year.
The salary is 50,000 dollars per annum.

a person who gives financial or other support to a person, organization, or cause.
The project found a generous backer.

influence or power
The company gained significant clout in the industry.

the act of deleting
The accidental deletion of the file caused problems.

animal excrement; manure
Farmers use animal dung to fertilize their fields.

a person who earns money
He is the sole earner in his family.

the process of making films
She is studying filmmaking at university.

a member of a subculture
She dressed like a goth, all in black.

a thorny shrub or tree
The hawthorn hedge was full of red berries.

a hidden store or supply
They discovered a hoard of gold coins in the attic.

a large group of people
A horde of tourists descended on the small town.

a small, mischievous devil or sprite
The little boy was a mischievous imp, always playing tricks.

the lower part of the digestive tract
Food passes from the stomach into the small intestine.

a planned route or journey
We received our travel itinerary for the trip to Italy.

a wild animal's resting place; a secret hideout
The bear retreated to its lair for the winter.

a means of survival or support
The emergency aid was a lifeline for the struggling community.

small amphibian
A newt can regenerate lost limbs.

nitroglycerin or nitrous oxide (informal)
The car had a nitro boost for extra speed.

material made from animal skin, used for writing
Ancient manuscripts were often written on parchment.

act of copying someone else's work without credit
The student was accused of plagiarism.

type of edible marine fish
Fish and chips are often made with cod or pollock.

letters added to the beginning of a word
The word 'unhappy' has the prefix 'un-'.

introductory part of a book or play
The novel began with a short prologue explaining the backstory.

Native American village or people
The ancient pueblo ruins are a popular tourist attraction.

raised platform in a church for preaching
The minister delivered his sermon from the pulpit.

quality assurance
The QA team is responsible for testing the software.

a person or thing that rips; something excellent (informal)
That movie was an absolute ripper!

a timid or cowardly person (informal, sometimes derogatory)
Don't be such a sissy, just try it!

thick, soft, wet mud or a similar viscous mixture
The riverbed was covered in thick sludge.

a track for motor racing
The race took place at the local speedway.

a member of a staff
A White House staffer briefed the press.

a person who takes something
Are there any takers for the last slice of pizza?
